ranking.free_tier_data_path: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report API (eia.gov/opendata) + FRED NGPSPONG + yfinance (VLO/MPC/PSX/XLY)
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long refiners (VLO/MPC/PSX) when EIA gasoline inventory build exceeds 1-sigma vs 5-year average, short XLY; weekly rebalance, 2005-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: Crack spread dynamics dominate refiner returns; retail gas prices lag wholesale by weeks, breaking simple passthrough logic

ranking.free_tier_data_path: NOAA Climate Data Online API (ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web) + USDA NASS Quick Stats (quickstats.nass.usda.gov) + yfinance continuous futures (ZC/ZW/ZS=F)
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long-only front-month ZC/ZW/ZS when NOAA soil moisture percentile divergence from USDA planting-intent surprise exceeds 1-sigma, monthly signal, 1990-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: Commercial ag funds and satellite imagery firms price in USDA/NASS reports within hours; weather surprises are increasingly random with climate volatility

ranking.free_tier_data_path: yfinance (KWEB, HSI, FXI, MCHI, ASHR) + Investing.com HKEX historical closes + FRED DEXCHUS
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long HK-listed dual-listings short NYSE ADR when premium/discount exceeds 2-sigma 90-day Bollinger band, weekly rebalance, 2010-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: Capital controls and regulatory crackdowns create one-way gaps that never converge; ADR delisting risk is non-stationary

ranking.free_tier_data_path: CBOE Daily Market Statistics (cboe.com/us/options/market_statistics) + CBOE VIX term structure + yfinance delayed options chains for skew
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long SPY/QQQ when CBOE equity put/call 5-day MA < 0.55 and VIX term structure in contango; exit on VIX backwardation, 2010-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: Free CBOE data is daily-aggregated only; true UOA and directional flow require expensive OPRA/WhaleStream feeds

ranking.free_tier_data_path: SEC EDGAR full-text search (sec.gov/edgar/search) for CAT/Komatsu 10-K capex tables + World Bank Commodity Price Data API (API_MKT_*)
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long copper futures (HG=F) when combined CAT+Komatsu YoY capex growth turns negative after 2+ consecutive quarters, 6-month hold, 2000-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: Capital cycle lead time is 2-5 years, producing very low Sharpe in standard annual-rebalancing frameworks

ranking.free_tier_data_path: TSA Checkpoint Travel Numbers (tsa.gov/travel/passenger-volumes) + Freightos FBX container index (freightos.com free tier) + CME FedWatch for event overlay
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long PEJ when TSA 7-day MA throughput exceeds 30-day MA by >2%, exit on crossover; 2002-2025 (ex-COVID structural break)
ranking.killer_caveat: Each sub-signal has different seasonality and structural breaks; TSA destroyed by COVID regime change and box office is noise

ranking.free_tier_data_path: CDC Wonder NCHS Annual Marriage Rates (wonder.cdc.gov) + yfinance (SIG, GLD) + fixed Indian festival calendars
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long GLD 30 days before Diwali; short SIG when CDC marriage rate YoY declines >5% for 2 consecutive years, 2000-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: CDC marriage data is released with 1-2 year lag, making it untradeable forward; India gold seasonality fully arbed by physical dealers

ranking.free_tier_data_path: SEC EDGAR API (sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar) + USPTO Patent Public Search API + SAM.gov Entity/Contract APIs
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long small-caps receiving first-ever SAM.gov prime contract >$10M in prior 30 days, equal-weight, 2000-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: EDGAR XBRL parsing is brittle; NLP for Samsung-vendor relationship extraction requires labeled training data that does not exist

ranking.free_tier_data_path: Polymarket public API (polymarket.com/api) + Kalshi API (trading-api.readme.io) + yfinance (XLE/XOM/GLD/IWM)
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long XLE/XOM when Polymarket Iran-conflict probability spikes >10pp in 48hrs; long IWM when election odds shift >15pp, 3-day hold, 2020-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: Only ~5 years of history with sparse relevant markets; election cycles are too infrequent for robust Sharpe estimation

ranking.free_tier_data_path: yfinance + OTCMarkets.com OTC Bulletin Board + EODHD free tier for delisted tickers
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Long <$1 stocks with 50-day volume spike >300% and no SEC suspension flag, 5-day hold, 2000-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: Extreme survivorship bias in free data; most delisted OTC zeros simply disappear from yfinance, making backtests fiction

ranking.free_tier_data_path: Morningstar API (limited) + Yahoo Finance fund pages + SEC N-SAR/N-CSR filings
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Buy-and-hold no-load S&P 500 index funds ranked by lowest expense ratio, annual rebalancing, 1995-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: This is wealth management fee optimization, not a trading alpha signal; PF lift on a tier-2 strategy is effectively zero

ranking.free_tier_data_path: yfinance (spotty historical fundamentals) + FRED + CFTC COT legacy reports + Glassnode free tier
ranking.minimum_viable_backtest_spec: Cross-sectional equity long/short on EV/EBITDA deciles within Russell 2000, monthly rebalance, 2000-2025
ranking.killer_caveat: User explicitly states standard signal sources are exhausted; 200 dev-hours for 0.15 Sharpe lift on crowded factors is terrible ROI

top_3_picks_with_reasoning.why: EIA weekly data is institutional-grade, completely free, and backtestable to 1982; gasoline inventory surprises have direct passthrough to refiner margins with only 35 dev-hours.
NOAA and USDA provide 30+ years of free granular data; weather shocks to planting and yield are among the most fundamental and backtestable signals for lifting the sub-floor FUTURES PF.
CBOE daily aggregates are free and stretch to 2010; put/call ratios and VIX term structure are validated risk-sentiment proxies that can improve EQUITY and ETF timing with moderate dev cost.

bottom_3_dismissals_with_reasoning.why: Mutual fund fee minimization is wealth management, not a trading alpha signal; it produces effectively zero PF lift and consumes dev hours better spent on actual strategies.
User explicitly states standard sources are exhausted; 200 dev-hours for 0.15 Sharpe lift on crowded factors (P/E, EV/EBITDA) is the worst risk-adjusted edge per hour in the list.
Free-tier data misses delisted zeros, creating fatal survivorship bias; backtests become fiction because failed penny stocks disappear from yfinance and OTC feeds.
